name: ludock
description: A self-hosted control panel for existing Docker game servers

scripts.build: bun run --filter @ludock/shared build && bun run --filter @ludock/backend build && bun run --filter @ludock/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @ludock/shared build && bun run --filter @ludock/backend typecheck && bun run --filter @ludock/frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @ludock/backend lint && bun run --filter @ludock/frontend lint
scripts.test: bun test --isolate ./scripts/test && bun run --filter @ludock/shared build && bun run --filter @ludock/backend test && bun run --filter @ludock/frontend test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
